thread.title: Today's Stock Market Volatile; Costco, Netflix Falter | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Today's Stock Market Volatile; Costco, Netflix Falter | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes were volatile in today's stock market action, as interest rates jumped to new highs in the wake of the September jobs report . The U.S. economy added 134,000 jobs last month — vs. the 180,000 estimate — with the unemployment rate falling to 3.7%. Top retail stock Costco ( COST ) sold off after its earnings release late Thursday. Meanwhile, IBD 50 stock Veeva Systems ( VEEV ) rallied after a price-target hike. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite fell 0.3%, trading near the day's lows and swinging between modest gains and losses in morning trade. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrial average both inched lower.
Earnings Reports: Costco Breaks 50-Day Line After the stock market close Thursday, warehouse retailer Costco reported strong fiscal-Q4 earnings, but warned it expects to report a "material weakness in internal control" related to IT systems. The retail stock is breaking down through its 50-day line with an over-3% decline. Shares hit the 20%-25% profit-taking level from a 199.14 cup-with-handle entry in mid-September.
Among the Dow stocks, Apple ( AAPL ) fell for a second straight day, declining 0.7%. Shares are trading just off their highs after setting a record prices on Wednesday, peaking at 233.47.

Please contact customer service CLOSE FANG stock Netflix ( NFLX ) extended a losing streak to four trading sessions early Friday with an over-2% fall. The stock is testing the 50-day line, as it looks to add a potential handle to a cup-shaped base. The relative strength line is lagging.
Fellow FANG member Amazon.com ( AMZN ) reversed lower, moving down 0.2%. Shares are at the 50-day moving average line.
IBD 50 Stocks: Veeva Systems Snaps Back Among the top growth stocks , Veeva Systems snapped back over 2%, reclaiming a portion of Thursday's 6% decline. Veeva had its price target raised from 100 to 110 by Bank of America. Shares pulled back to their 10-week line where they are trying to find support. Veeva stock quickly hit the 20%-25% profit-taking range from a 84.34 double-bottom entry.
On the downside, Illumina ( ILMN ) fell 3%, breaking below its 50-day line for the first time since a breakout above a 256.74 buy point on May 7. Shares are above the profit-taking level.
